definitions.short: Lesha , a place probably East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3962. Lesha [ לֶ֫שַׁע ] proper name, of a location near Sodom and Gomorrah , only לָ֑שַׁע Gen 10:19 ; ᵐ5 D Δασα ; E ᵐ5 L Λασα ; site unknown; = Kallirrho -, with hot-springs, Jerome Quaest in Gen, (10.19) , compare Buhl Geogr 123 and references
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring;
